label: Leonardo da Vinci
variants: Lionardo di ser Piero da Vinci
Leonardo di ser Piero da Vinci
summary: Painter, draughtsman, engineer and writer, born near Vinci in 1452, died at Cloux near Amboise in 1519. The subject of this database; his life events, works and manuscripts are recorded as separate entities.

value.text: 15 April 1452, Saturday, at the third hour of the night

claims.statement: His grandfather Antonio da Vinci recorded the birth of a grandson, son of ser Piero, on Saturday 15 April 1452 at the third hour of the night, and his baptism the following day.

sources.cite: Recalled content of Antonio da Vinci's family note; not checked in this session.

check_in: Villata 1999, the first document (Antonio da Vinci's note)

claims.statement: Died at Cloux near Amboise on 2 May 1519. Melzi's letter to Leonardo's half brothers reports the death.

sources.cite: First chronology draft (2026-10-09) and recall; see e-death.

claims.statement: Born to ser Piero da Vinci outside marriage. The 1457 Florentine tax return (catasto) of Antonio da Vinci lists him among the household as a son of ser Piero, not legitimate.

sources.cite: Recalled content of the 1457 catasto declaration; not checked in this session.

open_questions: The identity of his mother Caterina is debated; see the persons research batch for the competing identifications.
